title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas is GTA 5 without the finesse - so why is the 2004 classic such a strange delight to return to?
text: There is a place in Whitewood Estates where a promising stretch of blacktop suddenly gives way to the desert. It feels like the road has been erased, a sentence left unfinished. It's quietly strange, a weird bit of urban wrongfooting. But I guess it makes some kind of sense. California, after all, is home to California City, a town that was planned and then never really built. It sits out there now, north of Los Angeles, streets laid out but slowly being eaten by the sand and dirt. Still, 14,000 people lived there as of 2018. Design limitation or something stranger, this digital dead end is a reminder that all of this land, so modern, so ancient - all of this is spook country. Read more

title: GTA 6’s Best Song Is A Nelly Furtado Cover From Azerbaijan
text: One of the mainstay features in Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto series is radio stations that can be listened to while driving in cars or, as in GTA 6, on the go if you acquire headphones. As a music-discovery vehicle, GTA: Vice City introduced me to many '80s classics across a variety of genres. With GTA 6 taking players to Leonida, in which Vice City is located, it's apt that the game features music that many probably would never hear anywhere else. One of the radio stations you'll find in the game is Kaleidoscope FM. It features covers of very-well-known songs that are performed by artists from around the world. It's a fantastic hook for a radio station and delivers some of the catchiest and most-unexpected covers from artists that have a pretty low profile outside of their home countries. The first song I heard on the station, and the one that remains my absolute favorite, is a cover of Nelly Furtado's "Say It Right" from Azerbaijani artists Alim Qasimov and Farghana Qasimova. The duo are known for performing Mugham, a type of music that blends poetry, melody, and improvisation. I had never heard of them before playing GTA 6, but the music instantly transported me to my youth listening to Qawwali, a type of music that is rooted in Islamic sufism . Initially, my exposure to Qawwali, a type of music that is over 600 years old, was limited to my own home, but it has since gained a worldwide following thanks to Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan , who is known as the King of Kings of Qawwali. These days it's pretty common to hear songs that either sample or are inspired by Qawwali, but, even so, hearing Mugham in GTA 6 was a huge surprise. I didn't expect to be playing Rockstar's latest opus and be reminded of Qawwali. https://www.youtube.com/watch?is=GsirJ2mQmdOdZt1a&v=6iA9fogYpLA I already love "Say It Right"--I think it's one of Furtado and producers Timbaland and Danja's best--but this cover draws out the melancholic soul that underpins the original, giving it a more emotional weight. Much of that can be attributed to the religious mysticism that both Mugham and Qawwali evoke. What I appreciate about this cover is how brilliantly it allows the unfamiliar to grasp what makes Mugham and Qawwali so beautiful by presenting it through a song that many people already have some familiarity with. Both types of music are performed by an ensemble, but the improvisational nature means that others are encouraged to contribute. The use of the kamancheh, tar, and daf, along with the vocals covering Furtado's chorus and the khananda's additions, come together to make the cover feel magical. There are other songs that will no doubt catch you by surprise on Kaleidoscope FM--another favourite is a South Asian cover of " Careless Whisper ." Naturally, I was intrigued by how this station came to be and, according to Ivan Pavlovich, Rockstar's vice president of music, it stems from an obsession that studio co-founder Sam Houser has. “Historically, we have always loved to champion a quirky, concept-driven station," Pavlovich told GameSpot. "Sam loves foreign-language covers of his favorite songs and thought this could be that station for GTA VI. Tracking down rights holders proved particularly tricky in certain countries." The biggest surprise, however, is the radio station's host: Academy Award winner Jeremy Irons. "Jeremy Irons has the perfect voice as the travel-weathered host telling tall tales of his adventures from around the world," Pavlovich added. "Jeremy loved the script, and nailed the wry humor of his character in one session. Hopefully, this station makes fans smile as much as we did when we were making it." Grand Theft Auto 6 reviews are available now. GameSpot gave it a 10/10, saying that it sets the standard for open worlds impossibly high.

title: How Xbox’s Streaming Deal For GTA 6 Could Expand Its Marketshare By 30%
text: Microsoft and Take-Two recently announced a deal to allow people to stream Rockstar's GTA 6 , and that significantly increases the game's addressable market on Xbox and means people can play the game for as little as $92. This is according to a newly issued report from Ampere Analysis , which said the streaming deal could reach the estimated 10 million "active" Xbox One consoles out there and expand the total addressable market for GTA 6 on Xbox by 30%. For anyone just catching up, Microsoft worked out a deal with Take-Two to allow GTA 6 to be streamed to an Xbox console--that could be an Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S, or even an Xbox One. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rAhUXOYNuH4 There are some key things to know, including how the game streams from an Xbox Series S version of the game and your streaming experience will depend on the strength and consistency of your connection. A report from Digital Foundry said the Xbox Series S edition of GTA 6 struggles with its frame rate at some points, but that might not be an issue for everyone. No such arrangement is in place for PlayStation, so the only way to stream GTA 6, at least right now, is on Xbox. Ampere said there are about 25 million PS4 consoles in the market that are still active, while Sony is the market leader for current-generation consoles with the PS5. Why do a deal with Microsoft and not Sony? Ampere said Take-Two was likely interested in the potential expanded reach with Xbox to help sell more units, but there might have also been a "direct payment" or a revenue-share agreement on Xbox that was more preferential to Take-Two. Ampere said Take-Two wants the PS4 audience as well via streaming, but that might not happen until 2027 at the soonest, if such a deal ever materializes at all. Beyond this, Ampere said there could be "technology-based reasons" why Sony didn't get a deal done for GTA 6 streaming. The research firm pointed out how Microsoft is a "hyperscaler" when it comes to streaming via its vast Azure network, which "puts it in a stronger position to serve a large influx of users streaming a brand-new game like GTA 6 compared to Sony." Lucia in GTA 6. "The favorable distribution costs to Microsoft as the service provider and owner of the cloud infrastructure also gives it a commercial advantage," Ampere said. "While PS5 users can generally stream their owned games as long as they have an active PS Plus Premium subscription, PS4 users don’t have that functionality. Essentially, Sony is not set up to offer its PS4 users the same streaming experience." Beyond all this, Ampere highlighted how PS5 users ($731) are spending more than PS4 users ($580) over the same lifecycle stage of each console. "Converting users to PS5 is more important to Sony than adding some sales of GTA 6 or PS4 users," Ampere said. Under $100 to play GTA 6 on Xbox Xbox's streaming deal for GTA 6 also makes Xbox the most affordable place to play GTA 6. Ampere said the total cost to play on Xbox could be $92, assuming the player already has an Xbox One, a copy of GTA 6, a controller, and a screen. Ampere did the math by estimating the cost to be 0.24 cents per hour to stream the game, for a total of $92 via streaming, assuming a 50-hour runtime for the game. This rate leaves little margin for Xbox, Ampere said, but the fact that people have to buy streaming time up front means there will no doubt be "a significant amount of playtime languishing in accounts that is never used." As announced previously, people can stream GTA 6 to their Xbox console via a Game Pass membership or by purchasing time without a Game Pass membership. The pricing is below. Cloud playtime packs pricing: 10 hours for $4 25 hours for $8 50 hours for $12 Coinciding with GTA 6's release and the new streaming deal, Microsoft just instituted limits on how many hours members can stream before being asked to pay more. These are: Game Pass Ultimate: 15 hours Game Pass Premium: 10 hours Game Pass Essential: 5 hours Even beyond the streaming deal, Xbox is the most affordable place to play GTA 6 considering that a new Xbox Series S console costs $500, compared to $600 for the cheapest new PS5. GTA 6 officially launches for everyone on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. title: GTA 6 Owner Take-Two’s Stock Adds Billions After Rave Reviews, But It’s Not All Good News
text: After more than 10 years of waiting, Rockstar's GTA 6 is finally available now (at least in New Zealand and Australia ). The anticipation has been sky-high for both consumers and investors alike, and Rockstar's owner, Take-Two, is seeing a huge uplift in its share price today after the game's overwhelmingly positive reviews landed. Take-Two shares rose by nearly7% in pre-market trading today, and moved higher from there as the day went on. This meant that Take-Two's market cap grew by billions today alone. Stock analysts expected share value to increase in the lead-up to launch, and many expect it to go higher still due to the expected launches of GTA Online and a PC edition of the game in 2027. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ftI6gjFsPuw&t=1s While Take-Two's stock price is popping today, Take-Two remains down close to 20% so far in 2026 and is down about 15% over the past 12 months. Why? No one really knows , because the stock market is fickle. Take-Two's stock price got hammered earlier this year when Google announced new AI software to make games, presumably spooking investors. The stock has not recovered since. The 52-week high for Take-Two is $265.65, and the 52-week low is $183.86. Zooming further out, though, Take-Two has been a fantastic investment for people who bought and held for a long time. As Rand Group points out, $10,000 invested into Take-Two when GTA 5 launched in 2013 has grown to more than $120,000 today. https://twitter.com/randgroup/status/2123139175881019530 GameSpot's GTA 6 review scored the game a rare 10/10. "GTA 6 is an astonishing open-world action game that I’d wager won’t be outdone until Grand Theft Auto 7," reviewer Tamoor Hussain said. GTA 6 has now unseated the Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 to become the highest-rated game of 2026 on GameSpot sister site, Metacritic, and is tied with the original Ocarina of Time for the highest aggregate review score ever . title: Bigfoot Is Back In GTA 6, And Apparently He Smells Revolting
text: Grand Theft Auto games have been home to some weird phenomena over the years, and in GTA 6 , it looks like Bigfoot is back and stinkier than ever. As the game steadily rolls out worldwide--or as people digitally immigrate to New Zealand for early access--streamers have been posting clips online of their encounters with the cryptid, and this time, it doesn't look like a man in a suit. It looks like the Bigfoot sighting is tied to a mission in GTA 6, as the mysterious creature is wandering the woods of Leonida and it takes off in a panic when you encounter it. Another clip shows a strange encounter in the woods, with the player interacting with an effigy that emits noxious fumes and knocks them out. In a brief cutscene, Bigfoots, uh, really big feet, can be seen approaching Jason as he drifts in and out of consciousness. In that first clip, Bigfoot is also covered in a cloud of fumes, which likely references stories about the mythical creature's potent stench. For GTA--and Red Dead Redemption--fans, this isn't the first time that they've been involved in a Bigfoot sighting, as encounters with it stretch back decades. https://youtu.be/4VB7nlJFM9I Back in 2004, rumors began to circulate about Bigfoot existing in GTA: San Andreas, but Rockstar dismissed these reports as false in 2005. A few years later, in Red Dead Redemption's Undead Nightmare expansion, protagonist John Marston was tasked with hunting down a pack of Sasquatches, and it was eventually revealed that the creatures were peaceful, capable of human speech, and now going extinct thanks to a certain trigger-happy cowboy. Bigfoot would appear in GTA 5, as getting 100% completion in the game would unlock a new mission where co-protagonist Franklin hunts down a creature in Blaine Woods, only to discover it was a man in a costume . As an extra joke, the Bigfoot impersonator drops a few references to Red Dead Redemption's infamous encounter, but that doesn't mean the real Bigfoot isn't lurking in GTA 5. You could use the thermal scope on the sniper rifle supplied to you to spot a bipedal creature watching you during the "Predator" mission, and eating a golden Peyote plant under specific environmental conditions would turn players into Bigfoot. Red Dead Redemption 2 brought an air of mystery back to the Bigfoot mythos, as you could find a gigantic skeleton half-buried in the snow high up on Mount Shann, and protagonist Arthur Morgan could also speak to an unseen figure that was heavily implied to be Bigfoot. Meanwhile, you can check out our GTA 6 guides hub for more details on how to make the most out of your trip to Vice City.

title: Don’t Expect To See Vice City For A Long Time In GTA 6
text: For those still waiting for GTA 6 to unlock, it's possible you have something of a mistaken impression of what the early hours will look like. Despite partially sharing a setting with GTA Vice City, you should not expect to be walking up the game's equivalent of Ocean Drive and Miami Beach in the opening minutes, as in the 2002 game. Far from it. As we noted in our video discussion on why we gave GTA 6 a 10/10 in our review , Tamoor and Jake did some expectation-setting. Rather than starting the game in Vice City, you'll instead spend the opening hours in a smaller corner of the state of Leonida, Key Lento. Vice City is undoubtedly the crown jewel of the game's world, but it could be as much as 20 hours before you reach it, depending on how you play. This seems to be a deliberate decision that, as Tam says, allows you to progress through the world at roughly the same pace as the ambitions of co-stars Lucia and Jason. The opening area may not be as glamorous as Vice City, but it is no less detailed than the rest of the game. It's possible it's only meant to last you around 5-6 hours, but we found it easy to get lost spending far more time than that, which resulted in Tam not reaching Vice City until after 15 or 16 hours. https://www.youtube.com/shorts/XkHgrxN3R4g Key Lento provides a good look at how the game and its simulation work, letting you eventually progress to a much larger space (seriously, the map is huge ) with a good understanding of how things work. All of this is to say, the glitz and glamor of Vice City are waiting for you--eventually. To make the most of the opening hours, be sure to check out our guide on what to do in GTA 6 first .

title: Jason Loves Cats In GTA 6, But Not All Of Them
text: Grand Theft Auto 6 co-protagonist Jason is, like many Americans, a fan of cats. Naturally, being an open-world game with seemingly endless possibilities, GTA 6 does indeed let Jason express that love by petting cats he sees. However, not every cat is down to be pals with Jason. As shared on social media, if you're walking around Leonida and spot a friendly-looking cat, you can go give it a pet. Jason even talks to the cat, because you'd have to be a monster not to, and the action even gives him a little focus boost. https://twitter.com/SolutionB2u/status/2123048280959672768 But not all cats are the same. Another clip shared online shows Jason carjacking someone, as one does in GTA. After driving away, loud meowing can be heard, and the camera cuts to inside the car as a cat viciously attacks Jason. A quicktime event is necessary to get the cat to stop, at which point Jason is able to stop the car and let the cat out. https://twitter.com/gtasix_/status/2123071228390842498 We can only imagine what would happen if that were a Rottweiler in the back seat of that car and not a sort-of-large cat. There are plenty of other animals to kill you while you're roaming Vice City and the rest of Leonida in Grand Theft Auto 6, and most of those would be less embarrassing to mention in your obituary than "cat." Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the most expansive and detailed games ever made, and if you're looking for some help, you can check out our GTA 6 guides hub as well as our guide on what to do first . In GameSpot's GTA 6 review , Tamoor Hussain said, "This game is the culmination of everything the developer has previously achieved in the open-world space that pushes the genre to heights that, in all likelihood, no other developer will be able to reach. GTA 6 is an astonishing open-world action game that I'd wager won't be outdone until Grand Theft Auto 7," ultimately awarding it a 10/10 score .

title: How Long Does It Take To Fly Across The Entire GTA 6 Map?
text: The Grand Theft Auto 6 map is absolutely massive , gigantic, and at least one more synonym to encapsulate its size accurately. Whether it's land, sea, or air, covering it is going to take a lot of time, but just how many hours should you set aside for a flight across Leonida? We found out for ourselves by piloting a single-propeller plane across the map, which took us an entire four minutes and 10 seconds between the two points on the map. That's pretty big! https://www.youtube.com/shorts/VHLzkTAAb74?feature=share We've known for a while that the GTA 6 map was going to be big--with roughly more playable space than GTA 4, GTA 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined --but even that claim doesn't put into perspective just how enormous the game truly is until you experience it for yourself. Another fascinating tidbit is that escaping GTA 6 is nigh-impossible , but definitely worth attempting. As one streamer has discovered, if you try to cheese it on water using a jet ski, you'll run out of fuel and be left stranded in the water. There might be a happy ending to this scenario, as some streamers have posted clips of a dog on a wave runner coming to their rescue. We've tried to replicate this ourselves, but we've had no luck yet. But if you choose to stay within Leonida's invisible boundaries, you won't run out of things to do for quite some time. Between missions to improve your lot in life, pursue relationship goals, and soak up the scenery, the reactive open world of GTA 6 will keep you entertained for hours. Our GTA 6 review gave the game a rare 10/10 score, and dozens of other reviewers worldwide have also been very impressed with what Rockstar Games has achieved. You can experience all of that for yourself soon, and if you're not planning to do some digital tourism with a long walk, check out our GTA 6 guides hub for all kinds of walkthroughs to help you survive and thrive in the game.

title: Rockstar Founder Issues Rare Statement As GTA 6 Launches To Superb Reviews And Huge Sales
text: We might not hear from him much, but Rockstar co-founder Sam Houser remains highly involved with the studio and its games, and that includes GTA 6 , which is available now in New Zealand and everywhere else on November 19. To mark the game's launch, Houser released a statement in which he said Rockstar has once again tried to create a game in GTA 6 that "exceeds your expectations" and shows "what this medium is capable of, and why we believe games are so special." https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rAhUXOYNuH4 He told GamesRadar : "Rockstar Games was founded on the belief that games could achieve the same distinction as all other forms of storytelling, become essential to modern culture, and to be thought of as stories and worlds that live on with us." The executive went on to say that he hopes GTA 6 feels "both familiar and entirely new," and above all else, something that people find to be fun. "This is a narrative set in a world of possibilities--and it is up to you as the player to shape how it ultimately feels, and concludes," he added. Finally, Houser reminded people that GTA 6 might be the pinnacle of the franchise so far , but Rockstar isn't closing up shop anytime soon. "We look forward to many more years of sharing these experiences with you," he said. It's possible it won't be another 13 years for the next GTA game, as Rockstar's owner, Take-Two, has said the "nature and velocity" of GTA releases will change. Sam Houser rarely releases statements, gives interviews, or appears in Rockstar's promotional efforts, so even this celebratory statement is notable. GQ writer Sam White recently posted a series of tweets (and then deleted them) saying an interview he had planned with Sam Houser fell apart at the last minute . On GTA 6, Sam Houser was involved in every aspect of the game's creative process . Sam Houser's brother, Dan Houser, left Rockstar in 2020 after the successful launch of Red Dead Redemption II. He started a new company, Absurd Ventures, which is working on an open-world comedy game that will be revealed soon. GTA 6 arrives for everyone on November 19, and it's expected to be a massive success, the likes of which the industry hasn't seen since ... 2013's GTA 5. In GameSpot's GTA 6 review, Tamoor Hussain said there might not be another game like it until the inevitable GTA 7.

title: The GTA 6 Police Don’t Have Equal Response Times For All Crimes
text: As with all Grand Theft Auto games, in GTA 6, the police will come after you if you commit a crime with witnesses. However, their response time will not always be the same, and you may be able to use this to your advantage, depending on the situation. As we learned during our time with Grand Theft Auto 6 so far, the police will respond more slowly if you are assaulting a gang hideout. Presumably, this is because the police force believes you're doing them a favor, but regardless, they will still show up if you get into an all-out firefight and make a bunch of noise. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rAhUXOYNuH4 We also found that, for this reason, using silenced weapons is extremely helpful, as the police will only be called if you are spotted or heard committing a crime. Of course, this is GTA, so you're still naturally going to screw up at some point and have a massive wave of police cars after you, but it doesn't need to happen all the time. title: “The “F**k Cut”– Resident Evil Movie Has A Version With A Lot More Swearing
text: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie includes a lot of swearing, with main character Bryan (Austin Abrams) saying the words "f**k" and "shit" over and over again as he faces a nightmare in Raccoon City. But the film could have had a lot more swearing. Cregger said in a new interview with Sony for the movie's home release, that, "The whole thing was carpeted with f**ks. You think there's a lot of f**ks in there now? You should have heard the rough cut. It was insane." Abrams said he isn't sure how many of the swear words were written into the script, saying there was "definitely a lot improvised." Cregger, who co-wrote the script with Shay Hatten, said the original script indeed had a lot more f**ks in it. "We tried to go in and take as many as we possibly could out of the movie. I think we probably pulled 70%," he said. Cregger went on to joke that there is a "F**k Cut" of Resident Evil out there. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CresXs8br9Q Similarly, there is a more comedic cut of the movie that exists. Test screenings showed that it was too funny. "So over the course of my testing, I stripped out as much of the jokes as possible,” he said previously . Cregger was previously in the sketch comedy group Whitest Kids 'U Know and has some fantastic comedy chops. Perhaps one day we'll get to see Cregger's original version of Resident Evil with more swearing and more comedy. The Resident Evil movie made more than $400 million globally and ranks as the highest-grossing film of Cregger's career and the top-grossing Resident Evil movie ever . Cregger won't come back for a sequel, though . He got a lot of hate from core gamers about his Resident Evil movie, which didn't feature any storylines or characters from the games, and is now pursuing only original movies as a director.

title: GTA 6 Finally Changed The Default Rockstar-Game Controls
text: If you've played Rockstar series like Grand Theft Auto or Read Dead Redemption over the past few decades, then you're familiar with their default control scheme, which maps sprinting to a face button instead of the left analog stick. But Grand Theft Auto VI isn't being hailed as a revolutionary game for nothing--at long last, the default scheme has changed. As we learned while playing Grand Theft Auto VI, instead of the default setup mapping sprint to a button (A on Xbox and X on PS5), the game maps it to the left analog stick. However, you're free to switch it back to the style used in games like Red Dead Redemption 2, if you prefer. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rAhUXOYNuH4 This is a very handy change, because mapping sprinting to a face button effectively stops you from being able to easily do some of your other actions, unless you have no dignity like me and will use your own face to press a button when your hands are full. The new default control scheme is far from the most impressive thing in Grand Theft Auto 6, of course. The game earned a rare 10/10 in our GTA 6 review , with Tamoor Hussain calling it "the culmination of everything the developer has previously achieved in the open-world space that pushes the genre to heights that, in all likelihood, no other developer will be able to reach." For more on the game, check out our ever-expanding GTA 6 guides hub and learn what you should do first . That shouldn't include buying a whole new pro controller , however.

title: GTA 6 Isn’t Worth Buying A Fancy Controller For
text: In all the excitement surrounding Grand Theft Auto VI (check out our 10/10 review ), it might be tempting to upgrade your setup. For a game 13 years in the making, is now the time to upgrade my TV? Maybe a PS5 Pro is in order? It's a coincidence I finally upgraded my speaker system after 18 years, I swear. One cheaper upgrade than those above you might be considering is a better controller, like a DualSense Edge or Xbox Elite controller. For all of their myriad upgrades, the most essential reason to ever buy one of these, in my opinion, is for the back paddles. Although they are not technically extra buttons, the ability to map an inconveniently placed button to one of them can make an experience far smoother. Some games make an exceptionally strong case for only playing with paddles. You do a lot of sprinting and picking things up in Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, and having to take my thumb off the right stick (thus temporarily locking the camera in place) is something I find to be a constant annoyance. It's such an improvement to be able to do those things while keeping my thumbs where they belong. Grand Theft Auto VI, on the other hand, is not such an example. Rockstar has finally made a change to the default control scheme it uses in its games, mapping sprint to a click of the left stick, rather than the traditional usage of the X (PlayStation) and A (Xbox) buttons. That alone alleviates a potential argument for needing back paddles (at least as much as one can need such a thing). https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rAhUXOYNuH4&t=1s That's not to say there's literally zero use for one of these pro-style controllers in GTA 6. In our experience, tapping a paddle is arguably still an improvement to clicking the left stick to sprint or holding L1/LB to bring up the weapon wheel. Enabling Focus Mode is done by clicking both sticks, which you might find awkward; accomplishing that with paddles might be comfortable for you. GTA 6 doesn't allow its controls to be freely remapped, though there are some options available (such as reverting to that previous style of sprinting). So while there are some reasons you may want to set up the paddles of your pro controller before diving into GTA, it's safe to say that buying one just for this game ain't worth it.

Here's what some reviewers have to say, and for more on the game, check out GameSpot's GTA 6 guides hub for an evolving collection of walkthroughs, tips, and tricks. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rAhUXOYNuH4 Grand Theft Auto 6 Platforms: PS5 and Xbox Series X|S Price $80 for the Standard Edition, $100 for the Ultimate Edition Release date: November 19 GameSpot -- 10/10 Only Rockstar commands the time and money necessary to make a game as dedicated to small details. And only Rockstar can execute on the realizing such a granular vision unimpeachably. The obsession with the minutia both explains and justifies the 13-year wait. This game is the culmination of everything the developer has previously achieved in the open-world space that pushes the genre to heights that, in all likelihood, no other developer will be able to reach. GTA 6 is an astonishing open-world action game that I’d wager won’t be outdone until Grand Theft Auto 7. -- Tamoor Hussain [ Full review ] IGN -- 100 Exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played. -- Luke Reilly [ Full review ] The Guardian -- 5/5 With realism that defies belief, this vast game easily accommodates its trademark foulmouthed, over the top chaos--as well as new empathy for the fugitive couple at its center -- Keza MacDonald [ Full review ] Destructoid -- 10/10 Grand Theft Auto 6 is part criminal come-up tale, part love story, and part life sim all wrapped up in an impossibly deep and detailed Rockstar Games open world that may never run out of things to do. For the last three-plus weeks, I have been gleefully vacationing in Vice City: robbing banks, fighting drug dealers, stealing cars, and enjoying the view while not coming close to finishing everything it has to offer. GTA 6 is finally here now, and it was well worth the wait. -- Scott Duwe [ Full review ] Eurogamer -- 5/5 A game of opposites and awe, minute detail and impossible scale, Rockstar pushes back the horizon of video games once again with GTA 6. An irreducible mix of silliness, intimacy, grand ideas and rock 'n' roll action - and a load more after that. -- Chris Tapsell [ Full review ] Bloomberg -- 5/5 It turns out that the secret ingredients to a great game are a lot of money, time and talented people. -- Jason Schreier [ Full review ] Game Informer -- 10/10 Grand Theft Auto 6 is a generational game that stands toe-to-toe with many of the great crime stories and satires across other media. It showcases both the entertainment value of interactive play and the current high-water mark for technical and artistic detail in games. Hunt for and count up all the minor faults or foibles you like, but then note how you just spent another hour lost in this remarkable escape into criminality, wanton violence, egregious sex, and the elusive potential of true love. -- Matt Miller [ Full review ] SiliconEra -- 90/100 Rockstar made strides in incorporating all the systems and the open world into the campaign in a satisfying way. But Jason and Lucia are the glue that keeps everything together. It’s their chemistry and complicity that made me want to experience everything, and it’s them that will keep me coming back. -- Daniel Bueno [ Full review ] Screenhub -- 4/5 At its core, GTA 6 is a pretty good game. There are large sections where it is an absolutely epic game, and large sections that are boring and too limited. However, after I pushed through the boring parts and it opened up enough to become a proper GTA title, it became worth it. Regardless of whether the game was good, it was always going to be an inescapable cultural moment. Luckily, it’s one largely worth participating in. -- Alice Clarke [ Full review ] Kotaku -- No score GTA 6 is a truly remarkable game. A masterpiece of open-world design that brings forward the best parts of all of Rockstar’s past games into one billion-dollar adventure that is unlike anything I’ve played before. It’s a game I’ll be playing for years, and I can’t wait to talk about it with others. -- Zack Zwiezen [ Full review ] The Verge -- No score It really seemed like no project could live up to the level of scrutiny that GTA VI has been and will be subjected to. title: GTA 6 Passes 17 Million Copies Sold And $1.6 Billion In Revenue On Eve Of Launch
text: The video game research company Sensor Tower has updated its GTA 6 sales tracker to reveal the latest, albeit unofficial, sales data for the open-world crime game. According to Sensor Tower, GTA 6 has now sold 17.07 million total units via pre-purchases, which works out to about $1.65 billion in gross revenue. The report said PS5 sales are dominating the mix, with GTA 6 selling 12.73 million units on PS5 so far, compared to 4.35 million on Xbox Series X|S. That means of the 17.07 million GTA 6 sales so far, 75% are on PS5 and 25% on Xbox Series X|S. In total, GTA 6 sales for PS5 have so far reached $1.23 billion in revenue, compared to $419 million for Xbox Series X|S. Sony and Microsoft keep about 30% of revenue due to their platform fees, so GTA 6 being a huge success directly benefits both of those companies. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wmKu9Uow-os The huge gap in sales between platforms is not surprising because the PS5 is dominating Xbox Series X|S in terms of console sales. In fact, GTA 6 is breaking records on Xbox , Microsoft has said, and the sales numbers for GTA 6 on Xbox line up with Xbox's share of the console market . Sensor Tower is projecting as many as 25 million total pre-purchases for GTA 6 by launch , and if the 75/25 split holds, that would be about 18.5 million units on PS5 and 6.5 million on Xbox Series X|S. GTA 6 is the most preordered game of all time for PlayStation and Xbox . If the 10 million pre-purchase number is real, that would break a record for most preorders set by Cyberpunk 2077 (8 million) . Sony holds the marketing rights for GTA 6 on PS5, but that doesn't mean that Microsoft is doing nothing to try to promote the game. Just recently, Microsoft announced a GTA 6-inspired custom Xbox console that sits inside an alligator. Circana has released new data that shows that GTA 6 holds 29% purchase intent among US console and PC gamers. That means nearly 1 in 3 console and PC gamers in the US plan to buy GTA 6 –this is the highest purchase intent that Circana has ever measured for any game. GTA 6 may indeed be a gigantic hit commercially, and one that helps lift the entire industry with increased sales of hardware and accessories. But anyone looking to buy a new console to play GTA 6 is set for major sticker shock, as consoles today are more expensive than ever. Not only that, but GTA 6 is not going to save the industry’s many serious and deep-rooted issues, experts believe . GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game's file size is about 212GB , and thankfully, preloading is already underway . The game unlocks on November 19 at midnight local time , and that means US players will be among the last in the world to get in. People in New Zealand, meanwhile, will be the first in the world to play GTA 6. If you're thinking about booking a flight to the land of Hobbits, here are some tips for packing your PS5 safely.

title: GTA 6’s GTA+ Subscription Includes A Free Supercar, Discounts, And More
text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is rolling out worldwide, and if you have a GTA+ subscription, you can pick up extra goodies for your trip to Vice City. Developer Rockstar Games has revealed that it'll be evolving its subscription service to cover both GTA Online and GTA 6, and for $8 a month, players can unlock several in-game benefits, including store discounts, more public transit options, and better haggling power. One thing to note: the services below are only available while you're subscribed, so if your membership expires or you cancel, those perks will no longer be available. Here's a breakdown of what you'll get if you stay subscribed. Venturas Blvd Elegy supercar and garage Looks do matter in Vice City, and nothing looks better than a '90 Annis Venturas BLVD Elegy supercar when you hit the streets. title: GTA 6 Has A Metacritic Score So High It’s Only Happened Once Before
text: Grand Theft Auto 6 has officially launched, and unsurprisingly, it's earning rave reviews. It's arriving hot on the heels of several critically acclaimed games this year, but does it have enough momentum to knock the current best-reviewed game of the year, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, off its throne? The answer is a resounding yes: not only is GTA 6 being reviewed higher than Nintendo's little hero in green, but it's also emerging as one of the highest-rated games of all time. When Ocarina of Time launched in early November, it quickly shot to the top of the Metacritic charts, earning a metascore of 96 from GameSpot's sister site. That score came from 128 reviews, and Metacritic rates it as "Universal Acclaim" on its scale. For GTA 6, the game is sitting on a review aggregate of 99 from 147 reviews at the time of writing, with just a single point keeping it away from a perfect score. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ftI6gjFsPuw GTA 6 is only the second game to earn a metascore of 98, and hilariously, it's tied with the original Ocarina of Time from 1998. Historically, GTA games have always had some of the highest review aggregates, especially after the series moved to the third dimension. Starting with GTA 3, mainline entries have all earned metascores in the high 90s, with Grand Theft Auto 4 being the highest-reviewed game in the franchise until GTA 6 came along. Here's a closer look at those metascores over the years.: Grand Theft Auto — No metascore Grand Theft Auto 2 — 70 Grand Theft Auto 3 — 97 Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas — 95 Grand Theft Auto 4 — 98 Grand Theft Auto 5 — 97 Don't feel too bad for Ocarina of Time losing its crown, because the only thing better than critical success is commercial success. The remake has sold more than 5 million copies globally in its first four days, and those numbers will keep growing as we enter the festive season. Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick recently reacted to the game's release, saying it's "terrific" and that Nintendo has every right to be proud of it. "This game is the culmination of everything the developer has previously achieved in the open-world space that pushes the genre to heights that, in all likelihood, no other developer will be able to reach. GTA 6 is an astonishing open-world action game that I’d wager won’t be outdone until Grand Theft Auto 7," GameSpot editor-at-large Tamoor Hussain wrote in GameSpot's GTA 6 review . If you're planning to start playing it, you can also check out GameSpot's massive GTA 6 guides hub for all the tips and tricks you need to explore Vice City.

title: GTA 6 Has A Clever PS5 DualSense Trick For Keeping You Under The Speed Limit
text: While the urge to be an absolute menace in Grand Theft Auto 6 is strong, nothing stops you from playing as a law-abiding citizen who sticks to the speed limit between missions. This option to avoid attracting local law enforcement's attention will probably be best experienced on PS5, thanks to one key advantage: the DualSense controller and its adaptive triggers. On PS5, GTA 6 players can keep their vehicle from going over the speed limit, as the adaptive triggers provide resistance when you get close to the legal limit. That doesn't mean that you can't break past that barrier, but the adaptive triggers will help you match traffic speed most of the time and stick to legal restrictions. That essentially makes it easier to control your vehicle and gives your index fingers a sense of how hard to press the triggers--useful when you're trying to avoid dinging your car by finding that sweet spot. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wmKu9Uow-os&t=2s This is just one of several vehicle-specific features in GTA 6, as the game borrows a few ideas from modern-day open-world games and puts its own spin on it. For example, you can summon your car via a smartphone app, which involves a Scooter Bros. employee appearing at your location, delivering your ride, and then disappearing into the sunset with the little two-wheeled ride they stashed in your trunk. Cars appear to be more important than ever in GTA 6, and stealing a fresh set of wheels is also something that has a little more friction to it, as you could boost a junker with an empty tank of fuel or an expensive sports car that has GPS tracking inside of it. title: GTA 6 Gym Workouts Have A Useful Trick That Saves You A Lot Of Time
text: You won't get muscles in real life without putting in some work, but fortunately, leveling up your pectorals in Grand Theft Auto 6 is much less strenuous. The only cardio you'll need to do is a series of finger movements on your controller, but admittedly, getting either of the game's protagonists into shape can be time-consuming. Fortunately, there's a trick that can help you cut workout times in half, which I wish I could apply to real life as well. Essentially, all you need to do in GTA 6 is make sure you're going to the gym as a couple. If you only focus on Jason or Lucia for a workout, then they'll gradually gain muscle and tone up on their own. But if you go as a pair, it doesn't matter who you work out with; both characters will gain and progress on their path toward becoming absolute units . That makes for a quick way to bulk up, though we still need to talk about Jason's gym etiquette . Pain and gains. This isn't the first time GTA has introduced gym gameplay mechanics to keep your protagonist in shape; back in GTA: San Andreas, players could frequent locations across the map and work on CJ's appearance. Not only could he increase his muscle mass and stamina by pumping iron, but CJ could also learn new fighting styles from trainers along the way. Working out in GTA 6 also has benefits, as lifting weights can improve overall health, while cardio activities like running and biking improve stamina. You can even track Jason and Lucia's workouts via a smartphone app, and there's an optimal time for them to train to maximize their efforts. You can do that either at a proper gym in the game world or, if you're on a budget, use the set of weights outside Jason's house. With GTA 6 out in the wild, players are quickly discovering just how much there is to do in Rockstar's massive open-world game. If you're one of them and looking for tips and tricks, check out GameSpot's GTA 6 guides hub for walkthroughs to help you out.

title: WoW: Forever Exploit Lands Streamers In Hot Water After Farming Thousands Of Gold
text: A lucrative World of Warcraft: Forever dungeon-farming exploit that netted some players hundreds of gold per hour has been hotfixed, and Blizzard is taking action against accounts that (temporarily) walked away with thousands in loot. For the dedicated few who have already reached max level in the new version of Blizzard's MMORPG, a new endgame dungeon, Blackmaw Hold, proved to be quite lucrative. In the dungeon, a room with 30 non-elite enemies proved to be the perfect spot for area-of-effect gold farming, since it's easy to access. As detailed by Wowhead , the farm was as simple as running to the room in question, killing all the mobs, looting them, resetting the dungeon, and repeating. Not only did the enemies drop anywhere from 25 to 50 silver each, but they also dropped items that could be sold either to a vendor or on the auction house for even more profit. And some players, including prominent streamers, did just that during Forever's second weekend. One streamer, Ziqo, who was previously in hot water for accepting illegal gold during the game's beta, revealed he made 4,000 gold from the farm. On stream, Ziqo named other streamers who did the same and said his only regret was choosing to sleep for four hours instead of farming longer. https://www.reddit.com/r/wowforever/comments/1xy5ncr/exploit_early_exploit_often_almost_5k_gold/ On places like the WoW: Forever subreddit , players worried about the effect such a huge amount of questionably obtained gold would have on the MMO's economy, especially since the game has been out for less than two weeks. Many called on Blizzard to take action against accounts, including streamers, who benefited from the farm. Blizzard issued a hotfix on November 16, making the enemies from Blackmaw Hold no longer drop loot. In a forum post the following day, Blizzard explained what went wrong and why it was taking action. While Blizzard said finding good farming spots is part of old-school WoW, the enemies players were farming in Blackmaw Hold were incorrectly dropping loot that would normally be reserved for elites, an obvious mistake. Players who ran the dungeon a few times and "benefited organically from the extra loot did nothing wrong" and don't need to worry, Blizzard said. However, a few "hundred players worldwide" spent "significant time exclusively farming that group of enemies." https://www.reddit.com/r/wowforever/comments/1xyp721/blizzard_partner_btw/ Those players are now in more serious trouble. Blizzard locked their ability to engage in Forever's wider economy following the exploit, and said it is removing gold they earned through "exploitative gains." Additionally, "significant abusers" of the exploit will be handed account suspensions. "As always, we advise all players to refrain from abusing game mechanics that are clearly unintended," Blizzard said. "We will continue to take action against intentional abuse." The Blackmaw Hold farm wasn't the first gold controversy in Forever, and it certainly won't be the last. During the game's beta, streamers were caught accepting suspicious amounts of gold and encouraging their communities to illegally buy gold on their behalf. As a result, Blizzard issued suspensions , made in-game changes, and made it clear it would crack down not only on accounts selling illegal gold, but also on those buying or accepting it. Farming exploits aside, Forever's launch has been relatively smooth, though Blizzard can't seem to decide how much experience players should get in dungeons . Despite Forever's launch breaking WoW concurrent-player records, it still wasn't enough to get the MMO nominated for Best Ongoing Game at The Game Awards 2026 .

title: WoW: Forever Weekly Player Numbers Are The Highest For Blizzard’s MMO In 15 Years
text: World of Warcraft: Forever continues to break ground for developer Blizzard, which revealed new stats related to Forever's already record-breaking launch. Forever launched on November 4, and it didn't take long for Blizzard to announce that the game, the third major version of Blizzard's MMORPG, was the biggest launch in WoW history in terms of concurrent and returning players. Now, Blizzard is revealing more launch stats. Holly Longdale, executive producer and vice president for WoW, announced on social media that Forever has "more people playing weekly than we've seen in World of Warcraft in 15 years." https://twitter.com/TheWindstalker/status/2122843024791314913?a=FKSezktdLuA2T7G_Je0&s=20 The tidbit translates to Forever having more weekly active players than any WoW release since the game's 2010 Cataclysm expansion. That's quite the accomplishment considering that time period also includes massively popular expansions like 2016's Legion and the release of WoW Classic in 2019. That wasn't the only statistic Blizzard had to share. It revealed that more than 15 million characters have been created in Forever, with nearly 1.5 billion quests completed so far. It also shared the game's deadliest boss, Archmage Arugal from the Shadowfang Keep dungeon, as well as nearly 29 million PvP kills and almost 197 million player deaths. You can check out the full statistics below. While fun, Blizzard's stats don't reveal the numbers that more than a few players are likely curious about, like Forever's most popular races and classes . For that, players have to rely on third-party fan sites that have tracked Forever statistics since launch. Forever's launch may be breaking records, but that wasn't enough to score the MMO a nod at The Game Awards 2026 . In other WoW Forever news, Blizzard recently made yet another big change to dungeons .

title: BioWare Is Dead, But Mass Effect’s Spiritual Successor Exodus Just Gave Us A Glimpse of A Spicy Romance
text: For the first time since its announcement during December 2023's The Game Awards, players are getting a look at the female player-character from its upcoming sci-fi RPG Exodus --which was full of Mass Effect DNA back when we previewed it in September. The default female version of main character Jun Aslan was revealed today via a seven-minute featurette showing off both female-Jun's face and a bit more of the game itself. The trailer also provided a glimpse of a brief romance scene between female-Jun and Suliman, who is one of the game's romanceable NPCs. Space-smooches confirmed. When GameSpot previewed the game, only male-Jun was playable, and we didn't get a chance to romance Suliman, but we did manage to earn his approval, suggesting he may be into both masculine and feminine Jun. We also didn't see the character creator, but there certainly appears to be one, as we see Jun sporting a different look during the romantic encounter with Suliman, with voice actress Carina Corti ( Mafia: The Old Country, Little Death ) providing Jun's voice throughout both scenes. Jun's male character model recently got a complete makeover after players complained his original look wasn't pleasing to the eye, but up until today, it wasn't clear who was voicing him. Today, Archetype shared that Stephen Oyoung ( Marvel's Spider-Man, Marvel's Spider-Man 2 ) will be voicing the character. The female-Jun reveal is followed by a featurette called Scrappy Salvager, featuring a behind-the-scenes look at Jun's origins and the way players' decision can impact Jun's trajectory early on in the game. Female-Jun is voiced by Carina Corti. "We think of players as the co-authors of our story, and that applies to Jun as well," game director Chris King explains in the video. Art director Mark Anderson describes Jun as a "little fish in a really big pond," rather than starting off as a typical hero ready to save the world. Additionally, the featurette goes into more detail about Jun's "precognition" ability, which allows them to see glimpses of possible futures. If interpreted correctly, these premonitions may help players make choices that benefit them. But misunderstanding them may lead to consequences that expand far beyond Jun and their friends. Due to the way the game's time dilation mechanic works, player choices can have unexpected effects that impact civilizations for centuries. Female-Jun and Suliman share an intimate moment. After the death of BioWare, it seems the Mass Effect formula will live on in Exodus, with its vast worlds, strange alien races, NPC romances, and narrative choices. It shouldn't come as a surprise, of course--Exodus developer Archetype Entertainment was founded in 2019 by BioWare veterans James Ohlen, Drew Karpshyn, and Chad Robertson. Exodus launches on April 7, 2027 and is available to wishlist now on the PlayStation Store , Xbox Store , Steam , and the Epic Games Store .

title: This Fighting Game Is Nominated For A TGA Despite Development Shutting Down
text: Earlier today, Geoff Keighley announced all of the nominees for The Game Awards 2026 , the annual celebration of gaming held in Los Angeles. Among expected nominees Grand Theft Auto VI, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, and Control Resonant was one surprising name: 2XKO has been nominated for Best Fighting Game, despite Riot Games announcing the end of the game's lifecycle earlier this year. Riot announced that "active development" for the fighting game, featuring characters from League of Legends, would end in December 2026. "Over the last few months, we’ve been monitoring 2XKO’s trajectory closely, and what we’ve seen is painting a clear, consistent picture," Riot said at the time. "While a lot of you jumped in to try the game and there’s an incredible community that plays every day, we haven’t seen enough players stick with the game to get to a path toward sustainability,” https://twitter.com/Play2XKO/status/2090514358560579947 Riot's fighter is joined in the Best Fighting Game category by Invincible Vs., Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, Avatar Legends, and My Hero Academia: All's Justice. 2XKO is also not the only game on this list whose future is in jeopardy; soon after it launched in April, Invincible Vs. developer Quarter up laid off reportedly 75% of its staff, while saying that future updates were dependent on the game's overall sales. UPDATE 11/18/2026 : Skybound has commented on upcoming plans for Invincible Vs. with the following statement: " We understand there have been some questions surrounding the future of Invincible VS, but we want to reassure players that we're continuing to support the game and have more content planned. Most recently, we launched Season 2 introducing Angstrom Levy as the game's third DLC fighter, expanding the roster to 21 playable characters, alongside the all-new Challenges Mode, giving players new ways to test their skills and earn rewards. Season 3 arrives in December, bringing additional content, challenges and the newest playable fighter, Agent Spider. Looking ahead, we have more content planned for 2027, with additional details to be shared soon. We're excited about what's ahead for Invincible VS and look forward to continuing to support the game and its community ." Grand Theft Auto VI received the most nominations for a single game at this year's ceremony with eight, including Game of the Year. Control Resonant and Resident Evil Requiem tied for the second-most nominations with six each, while Phantom Blade Zero rounded out the top three with five nominations. Nintendo earned the most nominations for a single publisher, meanwhile, with 12 across the event's 30 awards. The Game Awards is set to take place December 10 live from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles, California.
